description: Urban Development Authority -  Maharagama Development Plan 2022-2031
categorisation: The gazette content primarily concerns the approval of a development plan for the urban council limit of Maharagama. This is a matter of land use planning and zoning, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land development projects and land use planning. While a government minister is named, the core subject is a land-related matter, not a government personnel or structural change.
